描述_ZN: Doucai Sanqiu cup, Ming Chenghua, 3.9 cm high, 6.9 cm in diameter, 2.6 cm in foot diameter.　　The Chenghua doucai cup has various styles, of which this cup is one. The cup has a flared mouth, a deep belly, a thin foot, and a rounded footrim. The interior of the cup is plain and without decoration. The outer wall is painted with two groups of floral designs of mountains and rocks, interspersed with fluttering butterflies. The blue and white color is light and elegant, and the overglaze colors applied are red, yellow and beautiful purple. The purple color applied on the butterfly wings is the famous beautiful purple color, which is characterized by its dense color and no light, and is the only Chenghua doucai, and is also unmatched by later generations of imitations. It depicts the scenery in a garden or courtyard in autumn, which generally lasts for three months, and is therefore known as the "three autumn cups". The footrim is covered with white glaze. On the outer foot, the two sides are framed in blue and white, with a six-character, double-line mark in blue and white regular script, "Made in the year of Chenghua of the Ming Dynasty".　　The cup is light and graceful, the body is as thin as a cicada's wing, the coloring is light and elegant, and the painting is fresh. The butterflies flying among the flowers and plants are especially vivid, reflecting the painter's excellent painting skills and artistic cultivation.
